sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €51.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
A few words from the foundry on this.
Thank you for your counter-offer and the proposed 24-month contract term, which we welcome as it provides valuable stability for both of our companies.
In recognition of our long-standing partnership and the extended contract duration, we are prepared to revise our offer to €51.30.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your revised offer; it is good to see we are nearing a conclusion. As a family-run foundry with deep roots in our region, we truly value the long standing relationship between our companies. We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. To bridge the remaining gap, we can make a further step to €50.10 per unit. 

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €50.10 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

I trust this fair compromise will allow us to finalize the agreement for the next 24 months. My team and I look forward to continuing our successful work together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. Thank you for your latest proposal, which shows we are now very close to an agreement. It is always a pleasure to work with your respected house, given the long relationship our companies share. 

To conclude our discussions, I propose a round figure of €50.00 per unit. This price honors our long-standing relationship and secures the 24-month contract term we both value. Along with a price of €50.00 per unit, our offer includes a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 December 2026. 

Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Please note that our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your latest proposal, which brings us within cents of an agreement.

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and the successful partnership we have built together over the years. However, a price of €50.00 per unit is our absolute limit for this package, and we cannot concede further. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. 

For complete clarity, our offer includes a price of €50.00 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 7 days.

I trust you will accept this final offer so we can continue our successful partnership.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
